# promptless — shell classifier for natural-language to opencode routing

A dual-mode terminal: known commands execute natively via your shell
(<10µs overhead), and natural-language prompts are routed to opencode
with native-style session management (no per-project session files,
no auto-resume).

## Architecture

```
Terminal input
    │
    ▼
classify_and_route()
    │
    ├─ command → native shell execution
    └─ prompt  → opencode run --format json --auto
                    │            (fresh, or --session <current>)
                    ▼
               format_output.py (JSON stream → terminal)
                    │
                    ▼
               current session id captured in memory
```

## Core modules

| Module | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Classifier | `lib/classifier.sh` | Word-boundary NLP heuristics, $PATH cache, session management |
| Session picker | `lib/sessions.py` | `/session` list + interactive picker (current-directory scope) |
| Formatter | `lib/format_output.py` | JSON event parser: text, tool_use, errors, token stats → ANSI terminal |
| Bash bridge | `shell/promptless.bash` | Readline macro chain (C-m → C-x C-p) intercepts Enter |
| Zsh bridge | `shell/promptless.zsh` | ZLE widget override of accept-line |

## Session management

Sessions mirror native opencode: the current session is tracked in
memory for the shell instance only (no `.promptless-session` file).
`/session` lists this directory's sessions and picks one to continue,
`/new` drops the current session so the next prompt starts fresh.
Consecutive prompts continue the current conversation; nothing survives
a shell restart.

## Requirements

- opencode in $PATH
- Python >= 3.6
- Bash >= 4.0 or Zsh >= 5.8

## Entry points

- `source shell/promptless.bash` — bash setup
- `source shell/promptless.zsh`  — zsh setup
- `bash test/test_classifier.sh` — 37 classifier tests
- `bash test/test_sessions.sh`   — session picker tests
